parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
*M1 main route: Use SUVAT from $A$ to $B$ with $u=0$ and their positive $a$ from (a)(i) to obtain positive $v^2$, e.g. $v^2=2\times0.8\times(\text{their }1.02)$.
A1: $v^2=(80-32\sqrt3)/15=1.64$ OR $v=1.28$; not $v=1.29$. Allow 2 sf or better without wrong work: $v^2=1.6$ or $v=1.3$.
*M1 main route: Find acceleration $B$ to $C$ by resolving both particles and eliminating $T$, or for the system: $2g\sin30^\circ-0.25g=(2+0.25)a$. Correct relevant terms; allow sine/cosine mix, sign errors and a consistently reversed acceleration direction. Reference $a=10/3=3.33...$ and $T=10/3$.
DM1 main route: Dependent on the previous two marks; use SUVAT from $B$ to $C$ with their positive acceleration from (a)(ii), not their acceleration from (a)(i), and their 1.28: $v^2=(\text{their }1.28)^2+2(\text{their }10/3)\times1.2$.
A1 main route: Velocity $=3.10\text{ m s}^{-1}$, awrt 3.10 to 3 sf.
Alternative using SUVAT in first stage and energy in second: *M1 $v^2=2\times0.8\times(\text{their }1.02)$ using their positive acceleration from (a)(i); A1 $v^2=(80-32\sqrt3)/15=1.64$ OR $v=1.28$, allowing 2 sf or better ($v^2=1.6$ or $v=1.3$). B1 change in PE $=\pm(2g\times1.2\sin30^\circ-0.25g\times1.2)$ OR change in KE $=\pm[\tfrac12(2+0.25)v^2-\tfrac12(2+0.25)(\text{their }1.28)^2]$. DM1 dependent: $\tfrac12(2+0.25)v^2-\tfrac12(2+0.25)(\text{their }1.28)^2=2g\times1.2\sin30^\circ-0.25g\times1.2$; six dimensionally correct terms, allow sign errors and sine/cosine mix on PE. A1 velocity $=3.10\text{ m s}^{-1}$, awrt 3.10 to 3 sf.
Alternative using energy for complete motion: B1 change in PE $=\pm(2g\times2\sin30^\circ-0.25g\times2)$. B1 work against friction $=0.3\times2g\cos30^\circ\times0.8$. B1 change in KE $=\tfrac12(2+0.25)v^2$. M1 populated equation: $\tfrac12(2+0.25)v^2+0.3\times2g\cos30^\circ\times0.8=(2g\times2\sin30^\circ-0.25g\times2)$; five dimensionally correct terms, must consider both particles, allow sign errors and sine/cosine mix on PE and/or work against friction. A1 velocity $=3.10\text{ m s}^{-1}$, awrt 3.10 to 3 sf.
Alternative using energy in two stages: *M1 official populated stage-one system equation $\tfrac12(2+0.25)v^2+0.3\times2g\cos30^\circ\times0.8=2g\times0.8\sin30^\circ-0.25g\times0.8$ (five terms, dimensionally correct, allow sign errors/sine-cosine mix on PE); OR $P$-only equation $\tfrac12\times2\times v^2+(\text{their }2.7559...)\times0.8+0.3\times2g\cos30^\circ\times0.8=2g\times0.8\sin30^\circ$ (four terms, dimensionally correct, same allowances); OR $Q$-only equation $\tfrac12\times0.25\times v^2+0.25g\times0.8=(\text{their }2.7559...)\times0.8$ (three terms, dimensionally correct, allow sign errors). A1 $v^2=(80-32\sqrt3)/15=1.64$ OR $v=1.28$, allowing 2 sf or better. B1 second-stage change in PE $=\pm(2g\times1.2\sin30^\circ-0.25g\times1.2)$ OR change in KE $=\pm[\tfrac12(2+0.25)v^2-\tfrac12(2+0.25)(1.28)^2]$. DM1 dependent on the previous two marks: $\tfrac12(2+0.25)v^2-\tfrac12(2+0.25)(1.28)^2=2g\times1.2\sin30^\circ-0.25g\times1.2$; six dimensionally correct terms, allow sign errors and sine/cosine mix on PE. A1 velocity $=3.10\text{ m s}^{-1}$, awrt 3.10 to 3 sf.
Printed total: 5.

parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
M1: Use SUVAT from $A$ to $B$ to solve for $t_1$, using $s=0.8$ and their positive $a\ne g$ from (a)(i), e.g. $0.8=\tfrac12(\text{their }a)t_1^2$; or $0.8=\tfrac12(0+\text{their positive }1.28)t_1$; or $\text{their }1.28=(\text{their }a)t_1$. Must reach $t_1=\ldots$.
M1: Use SUVAT from $B$ to $C$ to solve for positive $t_2$, using $s=1.2$, their positive $a\ne g$ from (a)(ii) (not (a)(i)) and their 1.28/speed at C, e.g. $1.2=(\text{their }1.28)t_2+\tfrac12(\text{their }10/3)t_2^2$, or mean speed, or final-velocity equation. Must reach $t_2=\ldots$.
A1: $t_1=1.25$, $t_2=0.547$; may be expressions. Allow $t_1=0.8/0.64$, $t_2=1.2/2.19$ OE, and 2 sf or better ($1.3$, $0.55$).
A1: Total time $=1.80$ s, WWW, awrt 1.80 to 3 sf.
Printed total: 4.
